description: This Java source file defines the `GeneralServiceException` class, which extends the `GeneralException` class. It serves as a base exception class for handling errors within the Ofbiz service framework, providing mechanisms to store error messages, nested service results, and to generate error responses.

classes.name: GeneralServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class used for errors occurring within services in the Ofbiz framework. It encapsulates error messages, nested results, and provides error reporting capabilities.
